sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Submit fantasy team handler
sections.what: Reads the team from the body, submits it for the signed-in fan, and returns a success flag and the team id.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the submit action.
sections.watch_out: Pages that read the team id depend on the exact response shape, so changing it breaks them.

summary: Lets a signed-in fan submit their fantasy team for a match.
purpose: Creates the team the fan enters into a contest.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the submit action.
how: 1) Confirms sign-in. 2) Checks the body against the team schema. 3) Submits the team through the contest service. 4) Returns success and the team id with status 201.
inputs: A POST with a JSON team body. The user comes from the session.
outputs: A JSON success flag and the team id with status 201.
risks: Team rules such as squad size and duplicates are in the contest service, not this file.
debug: If a team will not submit, check the team schema and the submit function in the contest service.
